_README: Hosted, OpenAI-compatible endpoints to benchmark alongside the self-hosted runs.
api_key_env names a variable in .env - never put a key in this file, it is committed.
rate_limit_rps is a HARD cap passed to aiperf --request-rate. Exceeding a provider's
limit produces 429s that look like latency and silently corrupt your TTFT numbers.
input/output_usd_per_mtok come from the provider's rate card. For a hosted endpoint
these ARE the cost - throughput does not enter the calculation at all.
ladder: concurrency rungs. Keep them low; you are measuring their rate limiter,
not their hardware, and every rung spends your token quota.
tokenizer 'LOCAL' means: use $TOKENIZER from .env (the extracted text tower), so no
gated HF download happens mid-sweep. headers are sent verbatim with every request.

publicai-apertus-8b.notes: THE 8B comparator: identical weights to the self-hosted text tower, and a PUBLISHED rate card, so this is a price comparison and not an efficiency proxy. Free tier caps at 100 req/min = 1.67 rps; the cap is set to 1.5 for margin. A User-Agent header is mandatory - without it requests are refused as bot traffic. Advertised context 262K, which is the one thing self-hosting cannot match on price.

swisscom-apertus-70b.notes: THE 70B comparator: identical weights to the self-hosted 70B, zero model confound. Bearer expires after 60 min. Free hackathon tier, so no per-token price exists - find the commercial rate or state plainly that you are comparing against a free tier.

vendor-b.notes: Copy this block per endpoint. Set verified=true only with a rate-card URL.
